title: [maintainer] README "Hack on the framework" should state what its commands cost on a fresh clone — `pnpm objectui:build` ≈ 10 min to get the Console, `pnpm test` ≈ 54 min — and point to turbo's `--affected` path for a contributor's own change
body:
Filing gate: ③ task dispatched by the maintainer, quoted verbatim below; the durations are class (a) measurements from this session on a fresh clone of `main`.
reach: README.md lines 220–229 ("Hack on the framework"), read by every contributor first; measured on a fresh clone (Node v22.22.0, pnpm 10.31.0, 4 vCPU-class container): `pnpm install` 16 s · `pnpm build` 6 m 54 s (72 turbo tasks) · `pnpm objectui:build` 10 m 36 s (shallow-clones objectui, builds the Console) · `pnpm test` 54 m 03 s (135 turbo tasks, 62 cached from the build).
Reader: `domain:devx` seat (`README.md` "Hack on the framework"; `CONTRIBUTING.md` once #22156 rewrites it).
Dedup: `search_issues` "README Hack on the framework pnpm test takes long objectui:build duration affected tests turbo --affected contributor guidance" → 0 hits. Related: #22155 (the Console step is missing from the same section).
Filed on the maintainer's instruction in this session (category ③, quoted verbatim): 「贡献者路径要说清时间成本。 README 三条命令拿不到 Console(已立 #22155),补上的 `pnpm objectui:build` 要 10 分钟;`pnpm test` 全量 54 分钟。建议 README "Hack on the framework" 直接写出这两个耗时,并指向 `turbo --affected` 的局部测试用法,否则新人会以为自己环境有问题。」

## Today

```bash
pnpm install     # Node 22+, pnpm 10 (corepack enable)
pnpm build       # build all packages
pnpm dev         # showcase example: REST + Console on :3000
pnpm test        # run the test suite
```

Four commands, no durations, no Console step, and `pnpm test` runs 135 tasks across 72 packages. A newcomer who runs it and sees nothing finish for twenty minutes concludes their machine or install is broken (this session did, and went looking for a hang before the log caught up). The same section says "REST + Console" while the Console needs the undocumented ten-minute step.

## Asked for

The block states what each line costs and what to run instead for a change:

```bash
pnpm install          # ~20 s
pnpm build            # ~7 min, 72 packages — required once; nothing builds implicitly
pnpm objectui:build   # ~10 min, clones objectui at the pinned SHA; only needed for the Console at /_console/
pnpm dev              # showcase example: REST (+ Console if built) on :3000
pnpm test             # full suite, ~1 h — CI runs this; locally prefer the two lines below
pnpm turbo run test --affected        # only packages your diff reaches (AGENTS.md: turbo ls --affected)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/<pkg> test # one package
```

Durations are order-of-magnitude, stated as "≈ on a 4-core laptop", and live in one place (README) with CONTRIBUTING.md pointing at it rather than repeating them.
